text:
taylor-security: Quick heads-up — kicking off a new access hygiene + attestation loop next week. We want to tighten admin entitlements, confirm owners, and cull stale service keys. Goal: reduce interactive admin seats by ~20% and remediate ownerless roles.

maria: 👍 can you share scope? org-wide or targetted projects?

 taylor-security: Target first: infra, staging, and analytics projects. If pilot looks safe we'll expand. Main asks: list of ownerless roles, svcacct keys >90d, and KMS grants to external projects. Also need rollback/runbook notes.

 devon: I can generate the canonical ownerless-role list from the iam-ownership DB. Filtering: last_activity > 180d and owner null.

 samir: Quick KMS question — if we revoke a grant, could onprem connectors fail rotation? need to know dependents before revoke. cc @ops-bot

 ops-bot: automated-checker: iam-ownership-scan scheduled and completed. Results summary: 47 ownerless roles, 12 service-account keys >90d, 3 KMS grants to external projects. Detailed CSV uploaded to https://internal.redwood/secure/reports/3123456789-attest.csv :lock:

 maria: Proposed 3-step plan: 1) notify potential owners + 7d RTT, 2) snapshot evidence package (logs, last-used, justification) stored in case ticket, 3) revoke / reassign after grace if no response. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

 devon: +1. Evidence query I used: ```sql
SELECT principal, role, last_activity
FROM iam_audit
WHERE last_activity < now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY last_activity ASC;
```
Use that to build the CSV.

 samir: For KMS grants, we should run a rotation smoke on staging before making any changes. If rotation fails, auto-rollback grant revocations. Also add a pre-check for external_project bindings.

 taylor-security: Good call. I'll book a Wed 10:00 AM infra-qa pilot window for the sprint. Volunteers for triage? need 2 people for service keys, 1 for KMS grants.

 maria: I'll take svcacct keys 1–6. Happy to draft the owner notification template.

 devon: I'll take svcacct keys 7–12 and the ownerless-roles reconciliation. Will attach the scripts to the ticket.

 samir: I'll own the KMS grant triage and staging rotation test. If anything red, I'll ping infra oncall.

 taylor-security: Perfect. Action items: add rollback snippets to runbook (devon), upload evidence CSV (devon), owner notification draft (maria), staging rotation test (samir). I'll create a single P0 ticket and assign.

 devon: Runbook snippet for quick rollback (draft): ```bash
# disable new grant changes
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key --member="serviceAccount:connector@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
# re-add if needed
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key --member="serviceAccount:connector@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

 ops-bot: ticket created: SEC-ATT-312345 (pilot scheduled Wed 10:00). Automated scan files attached.

 maria: Thanks — will post owner notif template here in a bit.

 taylor-security: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after pilot and decide full rollout cadence. :white_check_mark:
